commercial_hypothesis: Offline premium Windows. Target at least NOK 20,000 cash profit per game, before owner wage/personal tax. Only consider several games after actual results prove worthwhile. Price, production budget and sales unvalidated; no spending authorized.
evidence_limits: Desk research. No playable prototype, paid demand for this exact hook, measured production speed, or owner acceptance. Working label, not cleared final title.
title: Lantern Hideaway — research label
hook: Find tiny moths in one dusk conservatory illustration; each discovery lights part of the scene until the whole shelter glows.
audience: Players of inexpensive hidden-object and relaxing observation games.
core_loop: Inspect and zoom; identify a recognizable target; click to collect and illuminate; use a hint when stuck; complete one scene.

evidence.claim: Travellin Cats February 2026 announcement says its games are main income; amount undisclosed. Paris is free and catalogue/DLC advantages do not establish per-title sales.
100 hidden cups weak response and negative review sample identify ambiguous target recognition as a failure mode. Reviews do not establish financial failure.

risks: A dense attractive illustration can take longer than the code.
Low prices require more copies and existing series have catalogue advantages.
No sales or fun evidence for this exact theme.
next_test: If preferred, first make one final-looking section with fifteen targets, zoom, hint and light-up reward within six to ten production hours. Proceed only if recognition and artwork are strong enough; do not assume a finished hundred-target scene will be automatic.
decision_reason: Conditional lowest-code alternative. Not selected; art productivity must be proved before claiming a three-to-five-day full product.
